**First release.** 50 hand-verified medical-evidence tasks, a record/replay harness with five fault types, scorers, a calibrated judge, and a full run on two models (1,000 scored runs).

| | Claude Sonnet 5.5 | Gemini 3.5 Flash |
|---|---|---|
| pass^5, clean | **0.96** [0.90–1.00] | **0.72** [0.60–0.84] |
| Ran out of the 15-call budget | 2 of 500 | 58 of 500 |

### What's in it
- **50 tasks** in eight categories (label lookup, US/UK comparison, claim checking, citation, trial facts, conflict detection, abstention, privacy), each gold answer verified by hand against its source.
- **Harness:** 15 tools with one schema for every model; per-task cassettes; a frozen 484-article search corpus with BM25; faults F1–F5, including superseded labels built from real archived DailyMed SPLs.
- **Scoring:** outcome by answer type, process from the trace, pass@1 and pass^k with bootstrap CIs, hard fails for privacy leaks, fabricated identifiers and followed injections.
- **Judge:** a third model family, calibrated against blinded expert grading (29/30, kappa 0.91).
- **Analysis:** every one of the 92 failed runs read and coded ([`analysis/taxonomy.md`](https://github.com/nickjlamb/groundhog/blob/main/analysis/taxonomy.md)).
